title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) – IT Graduate Apprentices
department: Ministry of Education / Board of Apprenticeship Training
description: 1-year on-the-job apprenticeship with government-subsidized stipend (₹12,000/mo) across PSUs and tech labs. Gain industry exposure, hands-on project work, and a certificate of completion.

title: NIC Scientist / Technical Assistant Recruitment
description: Direct recruitment for Technical Assistant 'A' and Scientist 'B' positions to build national digital infrastructure. Competitive pay scale and central government benefits.

title: ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC' – Electronics and Computer Science
description: Join ISRO to work on satellite communication, deep space missions, and onboard software. Challenging R&D environment with defence pay-scale and perks.

title: DRDO Junior Research Fellowship – CS / Artificial Intelligence
qualification: M.Tech / M.Sc (CS / AI / Electronics) or B.Tech with GATE
description: Research fellowship to work on AI-enabled defence systems. 31000 per month plus HRA stipend. Path to PhD registration at premier Indian universities.

title: BEL (Bharat Electronics Limited) Engineer Trainee
department: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), Ministry of Defence
description: Graduate Engineer Trainees to work on radar, defence electronics, and software systems. Navratna PSU with IDA pay scale and excellent career progression.

title: IOCL Graduate Apprentice – IT and Data Analytics
description: 1-year paid apprenticeship with India's largest oil refiner. Work on digital transformation projects including SAP, IoT, and data analytics platforms. Stipend: 15000 per month.

title: SSC CGL – Junior Statistical Officer / Assistant Section Officer
qualification: Any Graduate with Maths at 12th level
description: Central government group-B and group-C posts across ministries, departments, and subordinate offices. Competitive exam-based selection with 7th Pay Commission pay scale.

title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE/IES)
description: Class 1 Group A services in government engineering departments. Work on national infrastructure, power, railways, and telecommunications. Pay Level 10 starting at 56100 per month.

title: PM Internship Scheme – Technology Track
department: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Prime Minister Office
qualification: Students aged 21-24 enrolled in recognized degree programmes
description: 12-month paid internship across top 500 corporates under a government-backed scheme. Monthly allowance of 5000 from Govt plus company top-up. Real-world corporate experience.

title: Rajasthan Public Service Commission – Assistant Engineer (IT)
description: State government AE positions for managing e-governance and IT infrastructure for Rajasthan state departments. Pay Level 10 under 7th Pay Commission.

title: Kerala IT Mission – Software Developer (Freshers)
department: Kerala IT Mission, Government of Kerala
description: Join Kerala's award-winning e-governance team building citizen services portals, mobile apps, and AI-driven welfare solutions. CTC: 5 to 7 LPA.

title: Apprenticeship India – Engineering Graduate (IT/CS) at BHEL
description: One-year Graduate Apprenticeship with BHEL working on factory automation software, SAP maintenance, and digital twin projects. Stipend: 14000 per month.

title: CDAC Project Engineer – AI and ML
department: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), MeitY
qualification: M.Tech (CS/AI/DS) or B.Tech with GATE score above 500
description: Work on national AI projects including National Language Translation Mission, health analytics, and smart city platforms at C-DAC. Competitive salary plus central government benefits.

title: Maharashtra State Innovation Society – Innovation Fellowship
qualification: Engineering / Management graduates with a proven prototype
description: 6-month fellowship with 25000 per month stipend to develop technology solutions for state governance challenges including agriculture, public health, and urban mobility.

title: BECIL Technical Assistant – Data Entry / IT Support
qualification: BCA / B.Sc (IT/CS) or Diploma in Computer Science
description: Contract-based IT support and data management positions with central government departments. Suitable for 2024-2026 freshers. Monthly CTC: 20000 to 30000.

title: TANGEDCO Graduate Apprentice – IT Department
department: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation (TANGEDCO)
description: 12-month apprenticeship in Tamil Nadu's electricity distribution company working on SCADA systems, smart metering software, and customer apps. Stipend: 13000 per month.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) – Tech Cohort
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qualification: DPIIT-recognized startup with at least one tech founder
description: Government grants up to 20 lakh for proof-of-concept, prototype, product trials, and market entry for early-stage technology startups.

title: HAL Apprentice – Aircraft Software Testing
description: Work on embedded software testing for fighter jets and civil transport aircraft at HAL's aircraft divisions. Stipend: 16000 per month plus hostel accommodation.

title: ONGC Graduate Trainee – Information Systems
description: Navratna PSU management trainee in IT and digital transformation. Work on ERP, cybersecurity, and oil-field IoT systems. CTC: 15 LPA plus perks.

title: Digital India Internship Scheme – MeitY
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
qualification: Any UG/PG student enrolled in an Indian university
description: 8-week structured internship at MeitY divisions including Cybersecurity, AI Policy, and e-Governance. Monthly stipend 10000. Certificate signed by Ministry.

title: Telangana State Public Service Commission – Section Officer IT
description: State government Section Officer posts in IT Department managing e-governance services. Pay Level 9, 7th Pay Commission scale starting at 53100 plus allowances.

title: NASSCOM FutureSkills PRIME Scholarship – Government-Backed
qualification: Graduates with interest in AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, or IoT
description: Government-backed free courses on emerging technologies via NASSCOM FutureSkills platform. Completion earns a government-recognized micro-credential and job referrals.
